rationale: Era's deep conviction in edge inference and on-device AI aligns with Manolo's focus on making voice systems production-ready and reliable outside the lab—both are solving the infrastructure layer for AI that actually works at the edge. Era's experience scaling deep-tech R&D at Edge (co-founded with a Transformer author) and Manolo's operational expertise in productionizing voice AI could inform each other on how to move audio intelligence from demos to robust deployment.
intro_message: Era Qian, meet Manolo Espinosa — you're both building production-grade AI infrastructure in San Francisco, and Manolo's work on audio reliability for voice systems could be a natural fit for the edge-deployed, privacy-preserving AI stack Era is scaling at Edge.
